justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/InvokeDynamic.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/InvokeDynamicTest.java`. The nested class `ForNullValue` is a small helper with minimal fan-out: it stores one `TypeDescription`, resolves to `NullConstant.INSTANCE`, and `prepare()` returns the input unchanged. Repo-wide searches found only one instantiation of `InvocationProvider.ArgumentProvider.ForNullValue` in `InvokeDynamic.java:663`, with no other direct references outside that file. That is not the high fan-in/high fan-out pattern required for hub-like modularization.
